independent_computation.step_1_ability_identity: data/champions.json -> Syndra.abilities.R[0].name = 'Unleashed Power'; targeting = 'Unit'; affects = 'Enemies'; damageType = 'MAGIC_DAMAGE'; spellEffects = 'spell'.
independent_computation.step_2_aoe_discriminator: In the same cache, Syndra's Q/W/E all carry spellEffects = 'Aoe'; R alone carries spellEffects = 'spell' with unit targeting. The cached wiki metadata classifies R as NOT an area-of-effect ability.
independent_computation.step_3_wiki_text: Active text: 'Syndra conjures 3 Dark Spheres and additionally grabs up to 4 nearby live ones. Afterwards, she barrages the TARGET ENEMY CHAMPION with all collected Dark Spheres, each dealing magic damage upon hit.' Follow-up effect: 'The Dark Spheres will then remain on the ground next to the target's current location for 6 seconds' -- the residual spheres deal no damage on landing. Notes confirm single-target semantics ('Casting Unleashed Power on a target that becomes untargetable...', 'Spell shield will only block the damage of a single sphere'). No clause spreads damage to secondary enemies.
independent_computation.step_4_sphere_arithmetic_consistency_che: Per-sphere magic damage 80/120/160 (+20% AP). Minimum (3 spheres): 3 x 80 = 240, 3 x 20% = 60% AP -> cache lists Minimum 240/360/480 (+60% AP) [OK]. Maximum (3 + 4 = 7 spheres): 7 x 80 = 560, 7 x 20% = 140% AP -> cache lists Maximum 560/840/1120 (+140% AP) [OK]. The cached leveling table is internally consistent and all of it is directed at one target.
independent_computation.step_5_cast_count: docs/math-foundations.md Section 5 formula-audit table, row 'Ability rotation casts (_schedule_shared_casts, _compute_ability_rotation)': verdict EXACT, edge-case column states '... R single-cast'. The 'Ability haste (effective_cooldown)' row states 'R casts exactly once per timed fight (model constraint, documented)'. The audit conclusion re-lists 'R single-cast' among the documented model constraints.
independent_computation.conclusion: Both admissible readings of the leaf converge on the same integer. Reading A (targets hit by R in the AoE fight): Syndra R is unit-targeted and barrages one enemy champion, so targets hit = 1 regardless of how many enemies are present. Reading B (R casts in the rotation): the documented model constraint is exactly one R cast per rotation/fight, so casts = 1. Correct value = 1.
independent_computation.why_absent_is_wrong: An absent leaf encodes either 'R contributes nothing to the AoE rotation' or 'R is not modeled there'. Neither matches the game: R still fires and delivers its full 240-1120 (+60-140% AP) magic damage to one enemy during a multi-target fight -- it is Syndra's single largest damage row -- and its Transcendent execute clause (below 15% max health at 100 Splinters) also still applies. Dropping the row understates the AoE-scenario total. The value is 1, not nothing.
